content.title: Advancing Fiscal Governance & Budgetary Science
content.description: As one of the few institutions in India specializing in budget studies, CBS addresses critical gaps in budgeting practices across national, state, and local governance levels.
content.paragraph1: The Centre for Budget Studies (CBS), established in 2012 by Cochin University of Science and Technology (CUSAT), is a pioneering institution dedicated to studying budgetary processes, fiscal management and their implications for governance in India. As one of the few institutions in the country specializing in budget studies, CBS aims to address gaps in budgeting practices at the national, state and local levels.
content.paragraph2: Through its flagship M.Sc. programme, the Centre provides advanced training in quantitative analysis, econometrics and financial technology, emphasizing research excellence and community engagement. Its vision is to establish itself as a Centre of Excellence in teaching, research and community outreach within the next decade.
content.sidebarText: Operating under Cochin University of Science and Technology (reconstituted Feb 1986), NIRF 32nd ranked university with top 1,500 THE world ranking.

content.title: Cochin University of Science and Technology
content.description: Reconstituted in February 1986 to promote graduate and postgraduate studies and advanced research across applied sciences, technology, industry, commerce, management, and social sciences.
Through its flagship M.Sc. programme, the Centre provides advanced training in quantitative analysis, econometrics and financial technology, emphasizing research excellence and community engagement.
content.eligibility: Bachelor's degree with university entrance qualification in Quantitative Economics, Mathematics, Commerce, or allied disciplines.

content.title: Vision & Strategic Mission
content.vision: To establish itself as a Centre of Excellence in teaching, research and community outreach within the next decade, positioning itself as a leader in budget studies and fiscal governance in India.
content.mission: CBS is committed to academic scholarship, rigorous research and meaningful social engagement while upholding institutional integrity, openness to knowledge and change, quality education and societal welfare. By fostering a safe environment that encourages freedom of inquiry and continuous improvement, the Centre aims to overcome challenges through strategic planning and innovation, ultimately positioning itself as a leader in budget studies and fiscal governance in India.
